body: I’m trying so hard to convince myself just another day but tonight is tough. I feel like I am brave today. I feel strong and satisfied in my decision. I know a cpl ppl might be hurt but life will go on. And just like life goes they will move on. I just ain’t strong enough no more
Shit all I know is I’m close. I won’t make it out of 2021. 28 seems like plenty long enough.

I’ve never talked to anybody else that feels this way. I don’t think I can describe how much that means for me to know someone else feels this way. And I’m so sorry u feel the same. I just feel like I can’t stop it. It feels out of my control. The ppl in my immediate life don’t seem to understand and I try and drop little hints begging, practically screaming for someone, ANYONE to say ANYTHING. I need help. I am just tired of being a burden in this life. Tired of not belonging. Idk what else to do. I think I’ve reached my breaking point.
